sources.title: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 optical archive
sources.notes: Sensor-specific processing and Landsat 7 SLC-off policy remain explicit.

sources.title: Sentinel-2 surface reflectance
sources.notes: Optical observations are retained separately from SAR.

sources.title: Sentinel-1 GRD SAR archive
sources.notes: Experimental; do not use as an optical gap-fill or merge into the optical series.

sources.title: Reported 1992 Imja bathymetric survey
sources.notes: Lead only. Evaluate original documentation, sounding count, positional method, tracks/points, and licence before ingestion.

sources.title: Reported 2002 Imja bathymetric survey
sources.notes: Reported as manual sounding; do not treat as equivalent to sonar without source review.

sources.title: Reported 2009 topographic/bathymetric survey
sources.notes: Distinguish measured soundings from interpolated/modelled bathymetry.

sources.title: Reported 2012 BioSonics bathymetric survey
sources.notes: Obtain original tracks, raw soundings, instrument configuration, positional metadata, and licence before ingestion.

sources.title: Reported 2014 SyQwest HydroBox bathymetric survey
sources.notes: Survey date, instrument use, data availability, and licence require original-source verification.

sources.title: Reported 2016 Garmin echoMAP bathymetric survey
sources.notes: Preserve the distinction between measured soundings and any published interpolation.

sources.title: Imja modelling supplementary archive on Zenodo
sources.notes: Do not automatically download or ingest the large archive; inspect contents, licence, and measured-versus-modelled status first.

sources.title: Reported 2012 GPR survey behind the Imja glacier terminus
sources.notes: Retain GPR acquisition and interpretation metadata separately from modelled ice thickness.

sources.title: NASA HMA2_DCG_SMB.001: 2 m DEM, surface velocity, and Lagrangian surface mass balance
sources.notes: Confirm Imja coverage and individual acquisition dates before use. Historical reference data, not current monitoring.

sources.title: NASA HMA 8 m DEMs derived from along-track optical imagery
sources.notes: Evaluate coverage, acquisition date, coregistration, uncertainty, and duplication with higher-resolution sources before ingestion.

sources.title: NASA High Mountain Asia Flood Geomorphic Potential
sources.notes: DEM-derived model product, not an observation, warning, evacuation map, or independent inundation model.

sources.title: Nepal Department of Hydrology and Meteorology and authoritative field observations
sources.notes: Integrate only through a stable permitted public method or agreement; do not scrape brittle endpoints.

sources.title: Imja monitoring and warning infrastructure records
sources.notes: Use confirmed-operational, confirmed-offline, status-unknown, or historical/decommissioned states; installation alone is not operational confirmation.
